lines.heard: Sketch y = ln of 2 - x. Four steps, asymptote, shape, draw, intercept.
lines.said: Sketch Y equals L N of two minus X. Four steps: asymptote, shape, draw, intercepts.

lines.heard: So the curve has the shape of ln of -x.
lines.said: So the curve has the shape of L N of minus X.

lines.heard: Step four, the intercepts. When x is 0, y is ln2, about 0.693.
lines.said: Step four, the intercepts. When X is zero, Y is L N two, about zero point six nine three.
